_readme: Hand-curated ratings, per business slug. "picks": true marks a business as one of Sara's Pick, a small, hand-curated list, separate from its rating tier; a business can be both Highly Recommend and Sara's Pick at once. "rating" is a manual override of the tier and always wins. The rating tiers themselves (Try at Least Once, Worth a Visit, Would Go Again, Highly Recommend, Local Favorite) now come from data/raw/business-rating-tiers.csv, which applies the rating rules to Sara's reviews. Tier names: try-once, visit, return, recommend, favorite. Example: "blendin-coffee-club": { "rating": "try-once", "picks": true, "reviewAuthor": "Dillon Loren" }
